policy: Owner 2026-10-05: not complete parity. Behaviour and feel (movement, collision, animation, combat, protocol, sound behaviour, HUD/UI) target retail. KEPT as deliberate upgrades, scored on correctness/robustness/perf rather than retail resemblance: volumetric clouds + physical atmosphere sky, lighting, post effects (bloom, aerial perspective, heat haze, tone mapping, terrain grass/dirt/snow particles), gore/ragdoll (blood decals, dismemberment, ragdoll deaths), higher-res textures (BC7/upscaled sets), HRTF 3D audio (retail stereo pan opt-in). NOT exempt: HUD conveniences - UI targets retail. Retail still governs what is visible where (e.g. outdoor objects through doorways) and anything affecting gameplay readability.
